name: Clear Lava - See Through Lava
summary: Makes lava semi-transparent (still animated) so you can see the terrain underneath before you jump in.
body:
**Clear Lava - See Through Lava** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It makes the lava texture semi-transparent so you can see what is underneath, while keeping the lava fully animated.

### What it changes
- Lava becomes semi-transparent (both the still and the flowing texture)
- The animation is preserved - the lava still moves exactly like vanilla

### Why players use it
- To see the ground and ores under a lava lake before crossing it
- To spot mobs or items hidden under the surface

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition). Client-side only.

---

Part of the **PvP Essentials** family: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low). Support the work on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/fliflight).
